text: EC survey results for M are published at the end of M; usable from day 1 of M+1
Monthly unemployment published about 30 days after the period
HICP flash at month end, final value in mid M+1
CZSO industry release on the 37th day plus at most 3 days of exceptions
CZSO import-price release on the 41st day plus at most 3 days
CZSO producer prices on the 16th day after the period, up to 9 days later in January
Monthly mean of weekly Rushin estimates; the last week is published about a week later

REER published in the following month

Weekly fuel survey published within days; monthly average after the last week
